summary: This bill designates the General George C. Marshall House in Virginia as an affiliated area of the National Park System, to be managed by the George C. Marshall International Center with technical and financial assistance from the Secretary of the Interior, but without federal acquisition of property or direct management responsibility.

scores.thoughts: The bill designates a historic house as an affiliated area of the National Park System. While this involves land management, the primary focus is on historical preservation and not environmental protection or regulation. The impact on the environment is negligible and indirect.
